about: Algebra skills a question needs (SCHEMA.md 'Skills'). A question lists ids in saccharine.skills; Cluck and the live visuals target them in plain words, no calculus. Audience: gen-ed students, many shaky on algebra.

families.units: Units, powers of ten and roots

skills.idea: A minus sign means 'the other way': -3 m/s is 3 m/s going left.
skills.slip: Drops the sign, or treats negative as 'smaller' instead of 'opposite'.
skills.visual: An arrow that flips the moment the value crosses zero.

skills.idea: Adding a negative takes away: 6 + (-2) = 4.
skills.slip: Adds sizes and ignores signs (6 + 2 = 8).
skills.visual: Energy coins: a blue chunk drops coins in, a pink chunk takes coins out.

skills.idea: A push against the motion takes energy away, so its work is negative; area below the axis on an F-x graph counts as minus.
skills.slip: Adds the area under the axis as positive (23 J instead of 22 J).
skills.visual: A t-mark crosses the pink chunk: the cart's speed meter drops and coins leave.

skills.idea: A change is final minus initial; going down gives a negative change.
skills.slip: Subtracts in the wrong order, so the sign flips.
skills.visual: Two dots on a number line with an arrow from start to end.

skills.idea: If y = kx, doubling x doubles y.
skills.slip: Adds instead of multiplies when one thing grows.
skills.visual: Two bars: drag one to double, the other doubles with it.

skills.idea: If y = k/x, doubling x halves y.
skills.slip: Expects both to grow together.
skills.visual: A rectangle of fixed area: stretch the width, the height shrinks.

skills.idea: With a square (v^2, r^2), doubling the input makes 4 times the output.
skills.slip: Expects 2 times (KE at double speed, gravity at half distance).
skills.visual: A square grid: double the side, count 4 copies.

skills.idea: Compare two cases by dividing their formulas so the shared parts cancel.
skills.slip: Plugs numbers into each case and loses the pattern.
skills.visual: Two formula cards stacked; shared letters fade out.

skills.idea: Get the unknown alone by doing the same thing to both sides.
skills.slip: Moves a term across and forgets to flip + to - or x to /.
skills.visual: A balance scale that stays level as both pans change.

skills.idea: Put one result into the next formula, with its units.
skills.slip: Uses a number from the wrong step or drops its unit.
skills.visual: Lego: one block's output snaps into the next block's slot.

skills.idea: Two unknowns need two equations (momentum and energy, two force directions).
skills.slip: Tries to solve one equation for two unknowns.
skills.visual: Two lines on a graph; the answer is where they cross.

skills.idea: ax^2 + bx + c = 0 has the formula x = (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a; pick the root that makes sense.
skills.slip: Drops the bx term or picks the negative root.
skills.visual: A parabola crossing zero; the physical root lights up.

skills.idea: Rectangle b*h, triangle (1/2)*b*h, trapezoid (1/2)*(a+b)*h.
skills.slip: Forgets the 1/2 for a triangle.
skills.visual: Lego labels: each chunk shows '[shape] - [formula]'.

skills.idea: Split a hard shape (or sum) into simple pieces and add them up.
skills.slip: Tries one formula for the whole odd shape.
skills.visual: Pieces pop apart, get labelled, then snap back with a total.

skills.idea: In a right triangle, a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
skills.slip: Adds the legs instead of their squares.
skills.visual: Squares on each side; the two small areas fill the big one.

skills.idea: The side across from an angle is hyp*sin(angle); the side next to it is hyp*cos(angle).
skills.slip: Swaps sin and cos.
skills.visual: Drag the angle: the opposite leg grows, the next-to leg shrinks.

skills.idea: The calculator must be in degrees for angles in degrees.
skills.slip: sin(30) in radians gives -0.988.
skills.visual: A tiny calculator badge showing DEG beside the angle.

skills.idea: Read a value off a graph: go across to the point, then over to the axis, with units.
skills.slip: Reads the wrong axis or misses the unit.
skills.visual: A crosshair snaps to the point with both readouts.

skills.idea: Slope = rise / run; on an x-t graph it is the velocity.
skills.slip: Reads the height instead of the steepness.
skills.visual: A staircase under the line: rise and run labelled.

skills.idea: Area under a graph = height times width, added up (F-x gives work, v-t gives distance).
skills.slip: Multiplies the end values only.
skills.visual: Strips fill as the t-mark sweeps; a running total grows.

skills.idea: Convert to SI first: cm to m, g to kg, km/h to m/s.
skills.slip: Uses 320 cm as 320.
skills.visual: A unit chain: 320 cm x (1 m / 100 cm) with cancelling units.

skills.idea: Units multiply like numbers: N*m = J, and the answer's unit must match the question.
skills.slip: Answers in the wrong unit and does not notice.
skills.visual: Unit blocks stack into J; a mismatch flashes.

skills.idea: 6.6e7 means 6.6 x 10^7; multiply the fronts, add the powers.
skills.slip: Types 6.6^7 or loses a power of ten.
skills.visual: A power-of-ten ruler that shifts as you multiply.

skills.idea: To undo a square, take the square root; only the positive root is a speed.
skills.slip: Halves instead of rooting (v^2 = 16 gives 8).
skills.visual: A square of area 16 shows its side 4.

skills.idea: Vectors add tip to tail; sizes add only when they point the same way.
skills.slip: Adds 3 N and 4 N at a right angle to get 7 N.
skills.visual: Drag the angle between two arrows; the sum arrow shrinks from 7 to 5 to 1.

skills.idea: Split a slanted vector into x and y parts and handle each line on its own.
skills.slip: Uses the full force along both axes.
skills.visual: A slanted arrow casts shadows on both axes.

skills.idea: When nothing outside pushes, the total before equals the total after (momentum, energy).
skills.slip: Compares one object only, not the whole system.
skills.visual: Before and after bars; the total bar stays the same height.
